description: User-configurable hooks fired at begin/end of each KBD phase step. Edit to add your own actions. Set enabled=true to activate an entry.

hooks.description: Post a Slack message when a phase reflection completes. Set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in your environment.
Append every begin/end event to a custom log file at ~/kbd-activity.log
Create a lightweight git tag at the end of each reflect step
macOS notification when any phase step completes (macOS only)

action.command: osascript -e 'display notification "kbd-${STEP} complete" with title "KBD -- ${KBD_PROJECT_NAME}"' 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.description: Print a reminder to check the assessment prompt before starting assessment

action.command: echo '[kbd] Reminder: check .kbd-orchestrator/project.json activePhase before assessing'
